## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one thing
- [ ] Headless tests pass (`python-qgis.bat tests\...`) on QGIS 4.x
- [ ] New or changed commands are in `permissions.py` with the correct risk category
- [ ] `command_help.py` and the README tool table are updated
- [ ] Destructive operations dry-run unless `confirm=true`
- [ ] CHANGELOG is updated
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal paths are committed
